ios.desc:
Symptom Tracker & Health Diary – Track Pain, Migraines & Doctor Visits

Symnote is a private symptom tracker and medical diary designed to help you log symptoms, track pain levels, and prepare for doctor visits with clarity.

Track your health daily. See patterns. Stay in control.

Track symptoms and pain levels
• Log daily symptoms and severity
• Track migraine, headache, stress, digestion, anxiety, and more
• Monitor changes over time
• Keep all health notes in one place

Ideal for chronic conditions, migraines, IBS, anxiety, and general symptom tracking.

Prepare for doctor appointments
• Review your complete symptom history
• Track triggers and improvements
• Bring structured notes to consultations
• Stop forgetting important details

Medication and health tracking
• Plan medication routines
• Create health-related to-do lists
• Track upcoming doctor visits
• Stay consistent with treatment

Private and secure
• No account required
• No data tracking
• Your health data stays on your device

Symnote is built for real daily use.
Track symptoms. Understand patterns. Feel prepared.
